1. (Currently amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving, by a computing device, a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating, by the computing device, at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the computing device __transforms the unique identifier into the at least use information by accessing and processing the stored user information__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __the computing device__ reading the unique identifier from the package.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __the computing device__ receiving information stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __the computing device__ searching a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4, wherein searching the data store comprises __the computing device__ transmitting the unique identifier to the data store over a network.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: __the computing device__ receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and __the computing device__ converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __the computing device__ receiving the at least use information from the data store.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of a product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __the computing device__ receiving user information regarding use of the product from __a user device associated with__ a user.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises __the computing device__ receiving an input through a user device.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises __the computing device__ receiving the user information regarding use of the product stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __the computing device__ receiving information from a secondary device.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium and a list of users.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __the computing device__ providing past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __the computing device__ receiving a user profile, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __the computing device__ generating the at least use information based at least partially on the user profile.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __the computing device__ generating an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: __the computing device__ reading a second unique identifier identifying __a second user__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: __the computing device__ comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier; and __the computing device__ generating a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, further comprising __the computing device__ generating one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, wherein __the second user comprises a caregiver providing the product to a first user, the method further comprising: the computing device__ storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __the computing device__ generating the at least use information customized to __the role of the second user__.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __the computing device__ generating the at least use information of a type customized for __a particular user__.

25. (Currently amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the user device further configured to communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information, wherein __the user device transforms the unique identifier into the at least use information by accessing and processing the stored user information__.

26. (Currently amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network, wherein __the computing device transforms the unique identifier into the at least use information by accessing and processing the stored user information__.

27. (Currently amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: __a processor configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product__; and __the processor configured to generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product__.

28. (Currently amended) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions for: receiving, by a computing device, a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating, by the computing device, at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein __the computing device transforms the unique identifier into the at least use information by accessing and processing the stored user information__.
